geometry.logical_accumulator: 8 block banks x depth 3000 x 96 lanes x signed19
geometry.physical_intent_not_yet_measured: each block bank is a single-port logical SRAM, width may later split as 13x144b; read-fold-write is serialized per bank

persistence: Accumulator SRAM survives phase release/config reload. operator_last_phase triggers a complete 8xROWS commit scan; ordinary phase completion does not commit or clear old_psum.
forwarding: One last-written vector per block bank forwards an immediately repeated same row address while all accepted updates are also written through to persistent SRAM.
directed_reduced_geometry: VCS may parameterize ROWS_PER_PHASE=1 and use three phases to prove PWP, fallback, plus/minus, cross-phase old_psum, same-address forwarding and an 8*ROWS operator commit. Production defaults remain 3000.
